senses.gloss: גַּלֵּיג (reduplic. of גל, v. גלה) to reveal (v. P. Sm. 723), to announce.
units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 36">Gen. R. s. 36</cite> <he>זיל גַּלֵּיג וכ׳</he> Ar. (ed. <he>זיל גְּלוֹג</he>, not <cite ref="G00354"><he>זילא</he></cite>) go, tell thy mother the good news; <cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 5">Lev. R. s. 5</cite>.—

<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 25">Lev. R. s. 25</cite>; <cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 2:20">Koh. R. to II, 20</cite> <he>איזילי גליג לאימיך</he> (not <he>גליגי</he>) I will go and tell thy mother. Pesik. Aniya, p. 137ᵃ [read:] <he>כל מה דאת יכיל למיגלג גלג למישבח שבח</he> as much as thou canst tell, tell; as much as thou canst praise, praise; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 339">Yalk. Is. 339</cite> (corr. acc.); (<cite ref="Pesikta Rabbati 32:1">Pesik. R. s. 32</cite> <he>דרוש וכ׳</he>).
<cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 10">Lev. R. s. 10</cite> is it these <he>דאת מִגַּלֵּיג עליהון</he> of whom thou art so boastful?
